* Anchor: The ghost cannot travel more than a mile from her remains.
* Ethereal: Ghosts are immaterial and can only be harmed by magical attacks.
* Fear –2: Ghosts cause Guts checks at –2 when they let themselves be seen.
* Hardy: Two Shaken results do not cause a wound.
